change_summary: Keep large selected sources out of Host model context, distinguish reviewed privacy projections from raw Agent-history exports, and preserve the existing bounded upload and organization loop.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill keeps large-source inspection bounded, routes raw Agent history to its reviewed importer, and lets safe user-selected projections continue through the ordinary Workspace value chain.

server_contract.note: The behavior contract remains backward-compatible at 2026-09-12.1, while the published Skill identity and the direct organization mission's corpus-coverage guidance advance together.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.25 with collaboration contract 2026-09-12.1.

workspace_cli.note: The existing CLI upload bridge and Local Agent Import authority remain unchanged.

help_center.note: Help distinguishes raw Agent-history import from reviewed projections and explains bounded inspection before a mechanical large-file upload.

package_setup.note: Package guidance mirrors the same large-file and history-projection boundary; the compact Claude hook remains unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The longitudinal archive gate now uses a hash-bound reviewed projection and tests the same retrieval, Work Model and Skill loop without weakening raw Host-history privacy.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover Host-envelope exclusion, access-code redaction, reviewed fixture provenance, package metadata and the next fresh J4 trigger.
